repository_card.frontier: The plane-tree/binary-tree equivalence and Catalan count are prepared for upstream use. No directly relevant new weekly Catalan-enumeration result was verified.
repository_card.bridge_hypothesis: The planar fertility-word encoding offers a second model for the same ordered trees. Dictionary: node child count minus one -> word letter; preorder -> ordered prefix sequence. Forgetting order loses multiplicities; fertility profiles alone need not identify trees.
repository_card.next_finite_task: Enumerate small plane trees and encode their preorder child-count-minus-one words. Check total weight -1, nonnegative proper prefix sums and round-trip decoding; compare counts with the existing Catalan convention.
repository_card.falsifier: Any collision between distinct plane trees or off-by-one disagreement with n+1 nodes invalidates the claimed bijection. Do not substitute symmetry-weighted counts for ordinary Catalan counts.
repository_card.proposal_status: speculative; not executed or formally verified

sources.title: The planar Hopf algebra of noncommutative multi-indices
sources.publication_status: preprint; peer-review status not established in this sweep
sources.review_depth: v1: abstract, Section 2 and fertility/coproduct construction
sources.source_claim: Yu, Gao and Manchon construct a planar noncommutative multi-index Hopf algebra, relate it to Munthe-Kaas-Wright through a fertility map, and describe left-admissible cuts and symmetrization.
sources.limits: Planar order and noncommutative products differ from the commutative Connes-Kreimer forest algebra. An algebraic correspondence does not supply analytic cluster convergence. First posted 12 July.
